chunks: Look, then how was the end of those who had been warned,

key_terms.الْمُنْذَرِينَ: those who were warned (by prophets or God)

ai.seo_question: What is the fate of those who were warned but ignored the message?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to highlight the inevitability of divine justice, serving as a historical precedent for the rejection of the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams by those who ignored their guidance. It underscores the theme that warning alone does not guarantee salvation, linking the fate of past nations to the contemporary community of believers.
